verdict.rationale: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is documented as a data exchange platform for securely sharing, discovering and accessing data across organizational boundaries without replicating it. Listings let publishers share data without copying it and can be monetized on Google Cloud Marketplace, and IAM roles apply at the dataset level. This delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: detail on the subscription/linked-dataset mechanics and the live-update behavior for consumers, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-org sharing.
